news.headline: Bengals look to end 2-game skid against Dolphins with Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins status unclear
news.detail: — Joe Burrow has thrown a lot of passes to Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, but the Cincinnati quarterback may need to find another top option when the Bengals visit the Dolphins on Sunday with both of his top receivers dealing with injuries.
